text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her peer, the martial arts girl Yaeno 
Muteki, says she polishes herself on the 
stage of racing for the sake of her 
master—her grandfather.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Compared to her dignified counterpart, 
Sakura Chiyono O possesses a slightly 
gentler, warmer aura.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet the moment she brought up her dreams 
of Maruzensky and the Derby, her sheer 
presence became so overwhelming that even 
Yaeno Muteki was left astonished.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Refusing to give up on that dream, the 
hardworking Umamusume Sakura Chiyono O 
charges toward her debut race!
